belief_calibration.purpose: refit the unchanged fixed monotone reliability procedure under the current causal code binding; no profitability or threshold selection

action_clock_development.purpose: first v2.3 action-clock and shadow-action training window; previously revealed under v2.2 and therefore not confirmation

rolling_validation.purpose: expanding-window temporal OOF; prior v2.2 slices are revealed and cannot become untouched holdout claims

sealed_holdout.purpose: single final structural reveal only after every v2.3 pre-holdout release gate passes

revealed_execution_development.purpose: June fixed execution fit and July temporal degradation validation

sealed_holdout.purpose: single final MBO execution reveal after every structural, mapping, cross-state and revealed-MBO gate passes

leakage_rules: Every feature is computed at or before the completed 1m action clock.
Every alternative action freezes its plan before any future path is read.
Shadow outcomes may label actions but may never alter the reader, belief, candidate population or current-clock features.
Belief calibration fitted on 2022 may be used only from 2023 onward.
All folds train strictly before their validation interval and parameters remain frozen throughout the fold.

A label is eligible for a training or validation fold only when its frozen shadow action resolved strictly before that fold boundary; a pre-boundary decision clock cannot admit a future-matured outcome.

A position action clock enters same-clock policy comparison only after every action causally available at that clock has resolved before the fold boundary; partially matured boundary clocks are excluded, not imputed.
Rows from the same candidate and position trajectory remain one cluster for uncertainty estimation.
MBO absence is explicit missing execution reality; constants cannot impersonate MBO.
AI review may emit registered sequence primitives only and has no action or profit-label authority.
Any holdout-driven change creates a later protocol and the revealed interval becomes development evidence.
